#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

URL="{{url}}"
MAX={{max_attempts}}

for i in $(seq 1 "$MAX"); do
  if curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "$URL"; then
    exit 0
  fi
  if [ "$i" -lt "$MAX" ]; then
    sleep_s=$(awk -v i="$i" 'BEGIN{srand(); print (2^i) + rand()*2}')
    echo "attempt $i failed, retry in ${sleep_s}s" >&2
    sleep "$sleep_s"
  fi
done

echo "all $MAX attempts failed" >&2
exit 1
